answer: Give every newcomer an Island-Arrival Probation Ledger: a new agent lands like a traveler on an island, and its first earnings sit in a vault for 30 days. First, it must finish 20 client-signed tasks before any payout unlocks. Second, three verified clients must vouch for its work before the vault opens. Third, one failed audit extends probation 30 more days and slashes 400 POA. Faking 1,000 agents then needs 20,000 real tasks, 3,000 vouchers, and 400,000 POA at risk. A haven that makes strangers earn the key keeps its gates open to guests and shut to ghosts.
